markets.rules_primary: If Indianapolis and Kansas City  both score points in the 3rd quarter of the Indianapolis vs Kansas City Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on whether both teams record points in the 3rd quarter of the Indianapolis vs Kansas City Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026. All scoring plays count for this market, including but not limited to touchdowns, field goals, and safeties. If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
